title: Apache binary hardening profile has stale RUNPATH and incomplete full-RELRO proof
title_de: Apache-Binary-Hardening-Profil hat stale RUNPATH und unvollständigen Full-RELRO-Nachweis
summary: Task-built HTTPD retained a temporary-build RUNPATH, while the module and libmodsecurity lacked observed BIND_NOW; the report does not validate reachable impact.
summary_de: Task-built HTTPD behielt einen temporary-build RUNPATH, während Modul und libmodsecurity kein beobachtetes BIND_NOW hatten; der Bericht validiert keinen erreichbaren Impact.
observed_behavior: Task-built HTTPD retained a temporary-build RUNPATH, while the module and libmodsecurity lacked observed BIND_NOW; the report does not validate reachable impact.
observed_behavior_de: Task-built HTTPD behielt einen temporary-build RUNPATH, während Modul und libmodsecurity kein beobachtetes BIND_NOW hatten; der Bericht validiert keinen erreichbaren Impact.
expected_behavior: Current evidence must be rerun against a known revision before this finding can advance beyond triaged.
expected_behavior_de: Die aktuelle Evidence muss gegen eine bekannte Revision erneut ausgeführt werden, bevor dieses Finding über triaged hinaus fortschreiten kann.
impact: Release and assurance claims remain bounded by the recorded evidence.
impact_de: Release- und Assurance-Aussagen bleiben durch die dokumentierte Evidence begrenzt.
preconditions: The retained assessment evidence and its referenced revision remain available.
root_cause: The retained evidence identifies the condition but does not establish a product-code root cause.
root_cause_de: Die retained Evidence belegt den Zustand, aber keine Produktcode-Grundursache.
proposed_remediation: Establish the intended linker-hardening baseline, assess runtime reachability, and avoid promoting this candidate to a vulnerability without evidence.
proposed_remediation_de: Die beabsichtigte Linker-Hardening-Baseline festlegen, Runtime-Reachability bewerten und diesen Kandidaten ohne Evidence nicht zur Vulnerability befördern.
acceptance_criteria: The intended RUNPATH/RELRO policy is documented and measured on released artifacts.
Any reachable impact is validated or the candidate has technical counter-evidence.
validation_plan: Inspect the rebuilt artifacts with available ELF tooling.
Run a legitimate host startup/control after any linker configuration change.
regression_tests: Add or retain a focused regression/evidence control for the recorded condition.
legitimate_control_tests: Run the unaffected allow/control behavior in the same scoped environment.
residual_risk: The condition remains open; no risk has been accepted by the current user.
residual_risk_de: Der Zustand bleibt offen; der aktuelle Benutzer hat kein Risiko akzeptiert.

history.detail: Created by the one-time finding-management bootstrap from retained evidence; no remediation, verification, closure, or risk acceptance was performed.
